2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch removes two unused helper functions, first_memory_node and next_memory_node, from the Linux kernel's nodemask code. These functions were previously used to get the first or next node in a specific state, but their usage has been replaced by explicit naming of the desired state. The removal of these helpers forces new code to explicitly choose a node state instead of silently defaulting to N_MEMORY.
